claims.claim: The default userspace disconnect sets flush_data=true; the kernel path prevents new dirty data and flushes a running cache before locking and stopping it.
KCAS_IOCTL_DISCONNECT_CACHE maps the userspace pass-through and flush flags into cache_mngt_disconnect_cache.
test_disconnect_default constructs a dirty WB cache, disconnects with default flags, and after reconnect checks frozen exported queues, zero dirty blocks, and unchanged core CRCs.
